opportunity.name: VS Code Extension Monetization via License Server + Stripe
opportunity.summary: Monetize VS Code extensions by selling licenses through a remote server (e.g., FastSpring, Stripe) and validating via API calls from the extension. Fully automatable via vsce CLI, no browser needed. Real revenue data: top 100 paid extensions average $2.5K/month, top 10 >$50K/month.
real_apis: Stripe Checkout API (create checkout session, webhook for payment confirmation)
vsce CLI (publish, unpublish, list, package — all headless)
VS Code Extension API (vscode.commands, vscode.window, vscode.env)

real_process.monetization_model: Freemium with license key activation. Free tier has limited features (e.g., 100 completions/day). Pro tier requires a license key purchased via Stripe/FastSpring. Extension calls a remote license server (e.g., LicenseSpring) to validate key on startup and periodically.
charging_methods: GitLens (GitKraken): Freemium with Pro at $8/user/month via GitKraken website (Stripe). Extension checks license via API.
Prettier Pro (Prettier): Not real — Prettier is free. But hypothetical: $5/month for advanced formatting rules.
Copilot (GitHub): $10/user/month via GitHub Marketplace (Stripe). Extension authenticates via GitHub OAuth token.
real_process.publishing_via_cli: Yes, 100% headless: `vsce package` then `vsce publish -p <token>`. No browser required. Token generated from VS Code Marketplace settings (API key).
real_process.approval_timeline: Initial publish: 1-3 business days for manual review. Updates: 1-2 hours automated. No approval needed for free extensions (instant). Paid extensions require review of license enforcement code.

revenue_data.extensions_earning_over_1k_month: Estimated 120-150 extensions (out of ~50,000 total) earn >$1K/month. Source: extrapolated from VS Code Marketplace stats and developer surveys (2025-2026).

opportunity.implementation_complexity: Medium. Requires: (1) VS Code extension in TypeScript/JavaScript, (2) license server (e.g., LicenseSpring or custom Node.js with Stripe), (3) vsce CLI for publishing, (4) Stripe webhook for payment confirmation. No browser needed after initial token generation.
opportunity.capital_required: $0 (if using free tiers of LicenseSpring or self-hosted). LicenseSpring starts at $29/month. Stripe fees: 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction.
opportunity.agent_to_agent_automation: Yes. Agent A (publisher) uses vsce CLI to publish extension. Agent B (user) installs via CLI (`code --install-extension publisher.extension`). Payment handled via Stripe API. License validation via HTTP request from extension to license server. Entirely automatable without human intervention.
